in_hebrew.name: Dory
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Dory הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Dory is a name for a sea goddess. The name Dory is derived from the Greek word 'doron,' which means 'gift' or 'prize.' In Christian tradition, Dory is associated with the biblical character Dorcas, a name which means 'gazelle,' and is also a form of the Greek name Dorothea, meaning 'gift of God.'
